item.title: Rescuing a Code Repository Accidentally Deleted by git-reset
item.description:
Some idiot mistakenly used git reset --hard. This is what happened to him.

The header image features adorable Rosemary! Drawn by Pixiv artist 赌上厨师生涯的拼好饭, here’s the original link. The track is a Touhou doujin piece I’ve been listening to a lot lately: encourager, the first track from 凋叶棕 (RD-Sounds)’s album 望 (Bou). The melody is positive and uplifting, bright and cheerful. The blonde kid on the album cover is so cute — can you even argue with that!?

item.title: One Year of the Blog!
item.description:
The header image is from bouquet by アシマ. The track is an insert song from a certain game, 玉響時間 (Tamayura Time) — it’s just incredibly pleasant, the kind that relaxes your entire body. Really wonderful, I hope you like it too.

I’ve decided to make September 22nd my blog’s birthday.

item.title: Setting Up an FRP Service
item.description:
Why do I have to first ToDesk into a Windows machine, and then SSH from that machine into the server just to connect!? Unbearable. Let’s just set up an FRP service myself.

The image features the lovely Ms. Bagpipe. According to unverified sources, it’s likely drawn by artist Liyu黎 as a celebratory illustration for the 2022 Ambience Synesthesia concert. To match, let’s play Ms. Bagpipe’s personal EP: 《故乡的风》 (Wind of Home).

item.title: Installing Arch Linux on a Laptop (Physical Machine)
item.description:
Installing Arch Linux on a virtual machine before was just not satisfying enough (lol, you didn’t even finish the series (x)), so this time I’m putting Arch on my little thin-and-light. And along the way, documenting the pitfalls you might hit on real hardware?

The header image is from R Sound Design’s new track 《アリス？》, a really cheerful Vocaloid song~ Bilibili submission

Sadly, both NetEase Music and QQ Music don’t have this song yet, so you’ll have to hop over to Bilibili to listen. Once there’s an update I’ll paste it right here
